toolCandidates.message: The file is executable but no shebang is present
More than one statement on a single line
standard import "atexit" should be placed before first party import "nova.monkey_patch"
Import "import atexit" should be placed at the top of the module
Import block is un-sorted or un-formatted
Imports from package nova are not grouped
Class 'DbCommands' inherits from object, can be safely removed from bases in python3
Formatting a regular string which could be an f-string
Use format specifiers instead of percent format
Unnecessary "else" after "return", remove the "else" and de-indent the code inside it
Consider using '{"method": migration_meth}' instead of a call to 'dict'.
Consider using ternary (1 if ran else 0)
Either all return statements in a function should return an expression, or none of them should.
Access to a protected member _has_resource_request of a client class
Lambda expression assigned to a variable. Define a function using the "def" keyword instead.
Variable name "NOVA_RCS" doesn't conform to snake_case naming style
Use `key in dict` instead of `key in dict.keys()`
Using `.strip()` with multi-character strings is misleading
printf-style format is resolved before function call; consider `_("string %s") % arg`
Unnecessary list literal (rewrite as a set literal)
